objective: Test whether local measurements improve held-out Ginkgo ranking and uncertainty coverage

materials_priority.system: Ginkgo CFPS or custom bulk standard lysate
materials_priority.caveat: Purchased lysate lots may differ from competition lots

materials_priority.system: Ginkgo CFPS Disulfide or corresponding bulk DSB lysate
materials_priority.caveat: Standard reducing lysate is not equivalent to the draft DSB preparation

materials_priority.use: Extract-based comparison with recorded lot composition
materials_priority.caveat: Separate effective parameters; compare known total concentrations, not supplement volumes alone
Different energy chemistry and background activities; no direct transplantation of fitted rates

work: use the supplied competition constructs with existing checksum/version provenance
calibrate purified matching sfGFP in assay matrices
use reverse product/substrate standards for PNP and AMC
record no-template backgrounds, spike recovery, actual dilutions and read timestamps
stages.gate: Readout conversion and matrix effects are documented; product rates are kept separate from protein mass and undefined enzyme units

stages.design: 12-condition magnesium x nucleotide panel; ranges set only after complete stock/base reconciliation
measurements: selected mRNA, ATP/phosphate and pH measurements where available
stages.gate: Add magnesium/speciation and explicit energy chemistry before fitting those mechanisms; do not absorb missing chemistry into unrelated rate constants

stages.design: Selected reference and diagnostic conditions for TfCut2 and reteplase, using target-specific lysate and incubation
stages.petase: Match p-nitrophenol hexanoate esterase assay and pre-assay heat/dilution; do not label it PET depolymerization
stages.reteplase: Match DSB lysate, 10h at 30C + 2h at 4C + 8h ambient, then IPR-AMC kinetics; optional independent abundance measurement remains a local addition

stages.design: Repeat shared feasible anchors across independent lots and 384-well, 96-well and 2-mL tube vessels
stages.gate: Fit lot/system/geometry effects separately and retain failed transfer outcomes

work: freeze locally calibrated predictions before receiving Ginkgo outcomes
compare with a Ginkgo-data-only baseline using the same training data and budget
hold out complete recipes and independent batches; count all replicates and confirmation wells
evaluate target-specific rank correlation, error and empirical uncertainty coverage
stages.gate: Claim improved Ginkgo prediction only after the held-out comparison; no local optimization result alone establishes transfer

submission_note: An actual Ginkgo plate requires the authoritative autonomous-cfps validator, 80 designs x four replicas in the stated participant layout, and reconciliation of the draft's extra-control ambiguity. No uploaded plate is produced by this plan.
